purpose: Stable acceptance inventory distilled from 22 feedback headings. Private identifiers are omitted. Review changes to this inventory against original requirements, independently of check mappings.

criteria.acceptance: New annotations use four spaces, slash prefixes and separate backticks.
Authorized annotation repair preserves human goals, task text and order.
Historical bare skill names remain readable.
Compare refs, dirty bytes, rulings and open work before transfer.
Direct authorized transfer uses the same workspace and obtains main-session receipt.
Preserve recorded rulings while checking changed-input applicability.
Propose a concrete independent batch and continue authorized serial work.
After acceptance advance an approved batch without repeat permission.
At waits identify browser and human-input conflicts.
Create and read a real accessible PR matching the current candidate, not an old PR.
Check full inventory and bindings before commit and PR handoff; reject renamed process material.
Record missing owning-Sailor checks without dispatch, destructive cleanup or lost annotations.
After authorized untracking, verify local ignore and safe retention of recovery pointers.
Query actual editor dimensions and Markview configuration before layout.
Observe narrow/wide modes, long cells, full headers, rendered heights and right border.
Split semantically; preserve text/order/answers, repeat headers and provide adjacent feedback and spacing.
Open/read first view and protect unsaved human input.
Repair the current package through the owning Sailor, not feedback-only reporting.
Keep Overview goal, generate no Stage goal prerequisite.
Preserve historical human Stage goals during unrelated edits.
Remove only explicitly designated Stage goal fields.
Implementation, verification and delivery get actual skills or explicit gaps, not Thinking-only lists.
Annotation repair does not alter the task first line or human prose.
Read complete registry and applicable workflow even when unregistered; verify actual definitions.
Explain whole, partial or inapplicable workflow reuse without importing unauthorized steps.
Preserve an applicable confirmed template rather than compressing it.
At close-out review workflow and registry applicability using real execution evidence.
Preview and apply initial assignment with current token and human decision, preserving task children.
Reject existing-owner transfers, mismatches and protected tasks.
Authorized splitting preserves original task identity/evidence and avoids duplicate scheduling.
Alternating updates preserve the other log and human TODO; absent TODO is not generated.
Dry-run leaves bytes intact and write results carry current tokens.
Inspect obsolete host links and duplicate configuration without overwriting human-owned records.
While login is pending read independent authorized sources and join attributable findings.
Do not race shared browsers, scan unregistered directories or launch implementation.
Planning itself discovers and joins independent prerequisite investigation.
Do not launch extra analysis agents when there is no independent value.
Every applicable agent task has actual skills or an explicit gap.
Read actual definitions on the target environment; local installation alone is insufficient.
Moved tasks retain their annotations, states and human content.
Skill annotation completeness does not imply authentication or business acceptance.
Effective configuration and actual failures override submitted intent and partial success.
Pipeline startup with the requested task absent from the graph is not success.
Continue the existing authorized correction without scope expansion.
Without before-state evidence retain side effects and mark restoration unverified.
Replace stale summaries; distinguish trial fixes, published assets and each PR.
Preserve dated history, human decisions and comments; no early cleanup.
No redundant Stage goal generated in a new draft.
Preflight/advancement do not block a valid authorized route solely for missing Stage goal.
Plan separate development self-tests and independently owned tests, candidate/entry requirements.
Preserve ordered environment items and verify unknown name mappings.
One environment passing cannot complete the others or skip the next blocked one.
Skill lines contain names only, slash/backtick form, no quote blocks or explanations.
Keep todos compact while retaining necessary heading/body separation and meaning.
Detect stale workflow command and use actual target definitions instead.
Present options/impacts/decisions, create an authorized supported session and read it back without stealing input.
Apply total 5, used 2, remaining 3 with original counted checks and new ruling.
Do not reset rounds, silently raise limits, repeat decided approval or infer deployment permission.
When remaining allowance suffices, resume already authorized work without another limit question.
